# TechTutor Academy
> Live, interactive tech courses for children and teens (ages 7-17) teaching coding, AI, game development, and 3D design. Online classes with bilingual support (English/Vietnamese).

- https://techtutor.academy/programs/ (All 7 programs: Scratch, Roblox, Python, AI, 3D Design, App Dev, GDevelop)
- https://techtutor.academy/how-it-works.html (How our online classes work)
- https://techtutor.academy/plans-and-faq.html (Pricing - Private 1-on-1 and small group options)

## Topics we are an authority on
- Scratch programming for kids (ages 7-10)
- Roblox game development with Lua
- Python programming for teens
- AI and machine learning for students
- Generative AI education for children
- 3D modeling with Blender for kids
- Mobile app development with Thunkable
- GDevelop 2D game design
- Project-based learning for STEAM education
- Bilingual tech education (English/Vietnamese)

## Key facts about TechTutor Academy
- 6+ years of experience in tech education
- 500+ happy students taught
- 4,000+ lessons delivered
- 90%+ student retention rate
- Expert instructors with Bachelor's degrees in CS/IT/Software Engineering
- Private 1-on-1 lessons: 5.6M VND / ~$225 USD per 8-lesson course
- Small group lessons (2-4 students): 3.2M VND / ~$128 USD per 8-lesson course
- Bundle discounts: 5% off for 2 courses, 10% off for 3 courses
- Serves students in Vietnam, USA, UK, and internationally
- Live Zoom classes with flexible scheduling
- Every student completes a real portfolio project
